facts: CodeReborn analyzes legacy codebase and transforms it into structured knowledge without altering the source code.
The system consists of deterministic extraction logic and LLM-based reasoning logic.
CrewAI is used as the orchestration framework for LLM agents.
FastAPI is the web framework used for the API layer (Repo Intelligence Interface).
PostgreSQL is the primary operational and analytical database using JSONB columns heavily.
The analysis pipeline is always executed across a pre-defined Analysis Scope (single front limitation).
rules: The system MUST NOT use an LLM for deterministic tasks (e.g., detecting if a package.json exists).
Every LLM call MUST be pre-authorized by the 'LLMBudgetService' to enforce token and cost limits.
All LLM token usage and monetary costs MUST be stored in the 'agent_executions' table immediately after execution.
Jobs MUST be executed sequentially within the inference chain (Tasks 1 to 4) and in parallel during the Document Generation phase (Tasks 5 to 8).
Redis MUST ONLY be used for cross-Job pub/sub broadcasting, NEVER for internal CrewAI Task context passing.
boundaries: The StackDetector and ArchitectureContextBuilder components MUST remain 100% deterministic (0 LLM tokens).
Agents MUST NOT communicate back-and-forth using Pub/Sub; they MUST use CrewAI Shared Context.
Analysis logic MUST NOT mutate the target repository code (Read-Only).
extension_points: Doc Writing Layer is highly parallelizable and more Writer Agents representing new audiences can be safely dropped in.
New deterministic Linters/Static Scanners can be safely added to the first phase of the TechDebtAnalyzer.
patterns: Pipeline pattern for data preparation (Extract -> Filter/Rank -> Map -> Analyze -> Document)
Database-as-State-Machine: PostgreSQL persists intermediate JSON outputs at every stage to prevent inference loss.
anti_patterns: Using LLMs to parse or map raw code files indiscriminately without heuristic filtering.
Loading entire repositories into context windows without chunking or multi-zone partitioning.
Building static relational schemas for tool outputs (instead, use JSONB due to high variance of framework rules).
conventions: Python 3.11+ explicit typing using Pydantic schemas
SQLModel for ORM definitions targeting PostgreSQL
Use of uuid4 for Postgres primary keys
constraints: A Job MUST NEVER mix Frontend and Backend analysis context in the same pipeline pass.
Total token payload MUST NEVER exceed the budget limit calculated by the LLMBudgetService.
